title: One context as a plotter
label: XY plotter: a bed of sixteen sunken wells, each a pane canvas; a gantry with a drag chain on its beam carries one webgl2 print head over pane 11. Move the pointer across it, or use arrow keys, to send the head to a pane.
caption: One WebGL2 context renders each pane in turn, then lowers and stamps its pixels into that pane's own canvas.
